{
  "summary": "The function computes a hash value using a simple linear hash function.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_11",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "1",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "The initial hash value is 0x1d35.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x1d35"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "The function iterates over each byte in the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "3",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "The loop increments the hash value by multiplying it with 0x29 and adding the current byte.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x29"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "4",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "The function returns the computed hash value as a 64-bit unsigned integer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "5",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "The function does not modify the input or output buffers.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_11(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0x1d35;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h = (uint)in[i] + h * 0x29;\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)h;\n}"
}
